database.query:
SELECT pd.id AS pack_id,
       pd.company_id,
       pd.system_id,
       pad.device_id_id AS device_id
FROM drug_tracker d
JOIN pack_analysis pa ON pa.pack_id_id = d.pack_id_id
JOIN pack_analysis_details pad ON pad.analysis_id_id = pa.id
JOIN pack_details pd ON pd.id = pa.pack_id_id
WHERE DATE(CONVERT_TZ(d.created_date, '+00:00', '-08:00')) = '{date}'
  AND d.filled_at = 11
GROUP BY pd.id
